# Legacy documentation

The files in this directory describe administration and launch workflows from OSCAR releases before 4.0.0. They are retained as historical source material and are intentionally excluded from connected and offline release packages.

Current release documentation is maintained in:

- `dist/release/QUICKSTART.md`
- `dist/release/DEPLOYMENT.md`
- `docs/OPERATIONAL_VIEWS.md`
- `docs/STATUS_OF_HEALTH.md`
- the four localized manuals under `include/osh-oakridge-modules/services/sensorhub-service-oscar/src/main/resources/com/botts/impl/service/oscar/i18n`

Do not rename or relabel a legacy document as a current manual. Update the maintained source and let the release workflow generate versioned PDF manuals instead.
